# TryIPTV

> TryIPTV is an independent prepaid IPTV subscription service providing streaming access to live television channels, live sports, and on-demand movies and series with 2 simultaneous connections across compatible devices and third-party IPTV players.

TryIPTV operates on flat prepaid plans with zero recurring contracts or auto-renewals. Subscriptions support both M3U playlist delivery and Xtream Codes-style API logins. A 24-hour evaluation trial is available with no credit card required.
